events.name: The Dusty Pickaxe
rumors: The lower mine went quiet a month back. Then the rumbling started.
Foreman Halvard won't sleep until the Heartstone is back where it belongs.
Rock trolls heal fast. Burn them if you can.
Renegade dwarves have taken the old camp in the upper mine. They'll take a bribe, mostly.
There's a drowned temple in the marsh south-west of here. Duskmere folk won't go near it.

events.name: Mine Head
events.text: A creaking lift lowers the party into the Thornwick Mines.

events.name: Mine Notice
events.text: BY ORDER OF THE FOREMAN: the lower galleries are CLOSED. Anyone who recovers the Heartstone will be well rewarded. - Halvard

events.name: Foreman Halvard's Office
events.text: A broad, soot-stained dwarf looks up. "Adventurers? Good. Something woke in the deep delvings - a wyrm of living stone. It took the Heartstone, the crystal that keeps the mine's air sweet and our lamps burning. Bring it back and Thornwick will not forget you."

events.name: Foreman Halvard's Office
events.text: Halvard holds the glowing crystal up to the lamp and laughs aloud. "The Heartstone! Take this ring - forged by my grandmother from the first ore this mine ever gave. And the forge will always have a fire for you."

events.name: Foreman Halvard's Office
events.text: "The lamps burn bright again below. Thank you, friends."
